categories.main_business_segments: Liaoning Kelong Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemical industry, focusing on the research, manufacturing, sales, and services of green, low-carbon new materials. Its main product lines include polyether monomers, polycarboxylate high-performance water reducers (concentrates and pumping agents), epoxy ethane derivatives, lithium battery electrolyte materials, denitrification catalysts, and surface active agents. The company also engages in the production and sales of concrete admixtures and commodity concrete.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced synthesis and polymerization technologies for polyether monomers and polycarboxylate water reducers, including proprietary VPEG polyether monomer synthesis and application technologies. It employs large-scale continuous production methods for epoxy ethane derivatives and fine chemicals, with patented processes for high-purity ethylene carbonate production used in lithium battery electrolytes. The company also applies spray drying technology to produce powder water reducers and has developed environmentally friendly, low-toxicity production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include concrete admixture compounding enterprises, ready-mixed concrete suppliers, railway, highway, port, bridge, hydropower infrastructure projects, and concrete component manufacturers. The company serves large infrastructure projects such as high-speed railways, highways, bridges, nuclear power plants, and municipal and civil construction sectors. It also supplies to international markets including the US, Russia, India, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in Northeast, Southwest, North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Northwest regions. It also exports products internationally to countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, including Central Asian countries, Malaysia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Turkey, and Chile. Production facilities are located in Liaoning (Liaoyang and Panjin), Sichuan (Chengdu), and Zhejiang (Hangzhou).
categories.supply_chain_position: Liaoning Kelong operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, producing key chemical intermediates such as polyether monomers and epoxy ethane derivatives. It also extends downstream into concrete admixtures and commodity concrete production through its subsidiaries, integrating vertically within the construction materials supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in polyether monomers and polycarboxylate water reducers, focusing on improving product performance and environmental sustainability. It invests in R&D for new products like nano early strength agents, solid alkali-free liquid accelerators, and alkaline hydrogen production electrodes. Strategic alliances with research institutes and universities support its innovation pipeline. The company also emphasizes expanding international markets and developing new materials for emerging sectors such as hydrogen energy and electronic chemicals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including polyether monomers, water reducers, epoxy ethane derivatives, lithium battery electrolyte materials, and denitrification catalysts. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with contracts signed for long-term supply to major infrastructure projects. Additional revenue streams include sales of commodity concrete and other construction materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic producer of fine chemical products, especially in polycarboxylate water reducers and epoxy ethane derivatives. It competes with other chemical manufacturers in the concrete admixture and fine chemical sectors. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and established relationships with major infrastructure clients. The company faces market competition intensified by capacity expansions in the polycarboxylate water reducer industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 558 million, a 28.46% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 100 million. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.27 billion, with net assets of RMB 508 million. The company experienced a decline in revenue and profitability due to macroeconomic factors and industry demand fluctuations but improved cash flow from operations. It maintains a mid-sized financial scale with ongoing investments in capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Liaoning Kelong emphasizes high-performance, environmentally friendly chemical products with proprietary synthesis technologies that enhance concrete performance, such as high water reduction rates, excellent slump retention, and durability. Its polycarboxylate water reducers are free of harmful substances and tailored for diverse construction needs including high-speed rail and nuclear power projects. The company offers comprehensive technical support and customized solutions, leveraging extensive application data and strong brand reputation to differentiate itself in the fine chemical and construction materials markets.
